prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. Muddy water bursts up out of a long crack in the dry earth and floods between collapsing goat-hair tents, small silhouettes in long wool robes wading away through it, rain hammering the ground. Night, rain and a flash of lightning. Frantic and dark. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
